propositions: Successfully posted outbound Jira comments must have their returned comment IDs recorded in the local comment_ids map; divergence (post succeeded but comment_ids unchanged) indicates a recording failure.
The invariant check must debounce across 2 consecutive reconcile passes — firing a bridge alert only when the same divergence is observed in 2 consecutive passes, not on single divergent pass.
Every successful comment post is tallied at the shared _record_comment_id seam before recording guards, so posts are counted even when recording no-ops.
Cross-pass debounce state persists in bridge_state/comment_id_divergence.json; a healthy observation (no posts or posts with map growth) resets the counter to 0.
The invariant check runs as a fail-open end-of-pass hook in _persist_and_log after binding-store save, generating deduped alert records through alert_store.
